prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Select a friend to see how they will interact with your desktop and windows.", "Select Companion Archetype"]
1: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your chosen pet companion and ensure automatic cloud recovery.", "Signing in ensures your pet state is saved if you reinstall or switch devices."]
2: ["Verify Desktop Overlay", "Can you see your pet walking on your screen? Confirm placement to complete desktop setup.", "Pet Is Visible on Desktop"]
3: ["Choose Your Pet's Voice & Sounds", "Pick how your pet reacts when you click or summon them on your desktop.", "Play Sample Bark & Purr", "Confirm Voice Style"]
4: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Roommate", "Your pet lives on your desktop, reacts to your windows, and keeps you company while you work."]
5: ["Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pet", "Log into your account to retrieve existing pets or back up your new companion.", "Cloud Restore Protection Active", "Sign In with Existing Account"]
6: ["Already adopted a pet? Sign into your original account to automatically restore your pet and settings."]
7: ["Building desktop graphics pipeline and pet animation engine. Please keep app open."]
8: ["Unlocked: Golden Companion Name Tag"]
9: ["Try Out Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Test these 3 essential controls right now so you know how to manage your pet on your desktop.", "Click to test: 1. Summon Pet  2. Hide to Tray  3. Open Chat Window", "Finished Testing Controls"]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency to lock in the chosen pet.
Mentions unlocked free extras or rewards.
